description: This file defines classes and functions for planning and managing distributed checkpoint save/load operations in PyTorch, including default save/load planners, plan creation, validation, and metadata handling.

classes.name: DefaultSavePlanner
classes.description: Planner class for saving checkpoints with options for flattening, deduplication, and plan caching.

classes.name: DefaultLoadPlanner
classes.description: Planner class for loading checkpoints with features for flattening, partial load, and tensor handling.

classes.name: _EmptyStateDictLoadPlanner
classes.description: Specialized load planner that rebuilds state_dict from metadata, useful for converting checkpoints.

methods.name: set_up_planner
methods.description: Prepares the planner with state_dict, metadata, and coordinator status.

methods.name: create_local_plan
methods.description: Creates a local save/load plan based on current state.

methods.name: create_global_plan
methods.description: Creates a global save/load plan, possibly with caching and delta computation.

methods.name: finish_plan
methods.description: Finalizes the plan, updating caches if plan caching is enabled.

methods.name: resolve_data
methods.description: Resolves data for writing, transforming objects as needed.

methods.name: lookup_object
methods.description: Finds an object in the state_dict by index.

methods.name: transform_object
methods.description: Transforms an object for saving, e.g., serializing to bytes.

methods.name: load_bytes
methods.description: Loads tensor or object data from bytes into the state_dict.

methods.name: resolve_tensor
methods.description: Resolves a tensor for loading, applying necessary transformations.

methods.name: commit_tensor
methods.description: Placeholder for committing a loaded tensor (no-op).

methods.name: lookup_tensor
methods.description: Finds a tensor in the state_dict by index.

methods.name: transform_tensor
methods.description: Transforms a tensor for loading, e.g., narrowing slices.

methods.name: set_up_planner
methods.description: Initializes the load planner with state_dict and metadata.

methods.name: create_local_plan
methods.description: Creates a local load plan based on current state.

methods.name: create_global_plan
methods.description: Creates a global load plan, possibly applying global plan logic.

methods.name: finish_plan
methods.description: Completes the plan, returning it as-is.

methods.name: load_bytes
methods.description: Loads data from bytes into the state_dict.

methods.name: resolve_tensor
methods.description: Resolves a tensor for loading.

methods.name: commit_tensor
methods.description: Placeholder for committing a tensor after load.

methods.name: lookup_tensor
methods.description: Finds tensor in state_dict.

methods.name: transform_tensor
methods.description: Transforms tensor slices for loading.

methods.name: set_up_planner
methods.description: Initializes the _EmptyStateDictLoadPlanner with metadata.

methods.name: _should_include_key
methods.description: Determines if a key should be included based on filtering criteria.

methods.name: create_default_local_load_plan
methods.description: Creates a load plan for local loading based on metadata.

methods.name: create_default_global_load_plan
methods.description: Creates a global load plan, default is identity.

methods.name: create_default_local_save_plan
methods.description: Creates a save plan for local saving, filtering tensors based on rank.

methods.name: create_default_global_save_plan
methods.description: Creates a global save plan and metadata, updating index hints if needed.

methods.name: _create_default_local_metadata
methods.description: Generates metadata for checkpointing a state_dict.

methods.name: _check_box_overlap
methods.description: Checks if two tensor chunks overlap.

methods.name: _check_box_bounds
methods.description: Checks if a chunk is within tensor bounds.

methods.name: _validate_global_plan
methods.description: Validates the global plan and metadata for consistency and overlaps.
